# Truphae

> > Truphae is a luxury fountain pen and writing instrument marketplace offering collectable pens, premium inks, and accessories from world-class brands.

Truphae specializes in curated collections of high-end writing instruments including fountain pens, rollerballs, and ballpoint pens from brands like Montblanc, Pelikan, and David Oscarson. The platform features over 1,000 bottled inks, pre-owned luxury pens, and a subscription service called Inkredible™ Box for pen enthusiasts and collectors.

## Core Collections

- [Truphae | Fountain Pen & Accessory Marketplace](https://www.truphaeinc.com): Truphae homepage featuring luxury fountain pens, inks, and accessories from top brands.
- [All Products – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog featuring fountain pens, inks, and accessories from all brands.
- [Writing Instruments](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/writing-instruments): Specialty writing instruments including ballpoint, fountain, and rollerball pens.

## Fountain Pens & Specialty Writing

- [Fountain Pens – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/fountain-pen): Collectable fountain pens from premium brands including David Oscarson and AP Limited.
- [Pre-Owned Pens – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/pre-owned-pens): Pre-loved luxury fountain pens from Montblanc, ST Dupont, Sailor, and Caran d'Ache.
- [Rollerball Pens – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/rollerball-pens): Rollerball pen collection featuring Diplomat, Pelikan, and Monteverde products.
- [Ballpoint Pens – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/ballpoint-pens): Ballpoint pen selection from luxury brands like ST Dupont and Delta Dolce Vita.

## Fountain Pen Inks

- [Bottled Ink – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/bottled-ink): Over 1,000 bottled inks including Pilot Iroshizuku, LAMY, and Colorverse brands.
- [Iroshizuku – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/iroshizuku): Pilot Iroshizuku fountain pen ink collection featuring Ajisai and Ama-Iro colors.
- [Herbin Inks – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/herbin-inks): Complete J. Herbin ink collection in 2ml, 5ml samples, and full bottles.
- [Robert Oster – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/robert-oster): Robert Oster Signature Australian ink collection with unique native palette colors.
- [Diplomat Ink – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/diplomat-ink): Diplomat from Octopus ink collection with 15+ colors for fountain pen writing.
- [Lamy Fountain Pens – Tagged "ink-inkwells" – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/lamy/ink-inkwells): Lamy fountain pens, inks, and accessories featuring affordable minimal design.
- [Monteverde – Tagged "ink-inkwells" – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/monteverde/ink-inkwells): Monteverde writing instruments and inks combining European materials with technology.

## Writing Paper & Stationery

- [Paper – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/paper): Writing paper collection including TOMOE RIVER, Traveler's Company, and refills.
- [Clairefontaine – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/clairefontaine): Clairefontaine premium pH-neutral acid-free notebooks with smooth satin finish.
- [LEUCHTTURM – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/leuchtturm): LEUCHTTURM1917 premium notebooks and planners with refined design and quality.
- [Lamy Fountain Pens – Tagged "paper" – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/collections/lamy/paper): Lamy paper products and stationery with minimal design and affordable pricing.

## Subscriptions & Special Offerings

- [Inkredible™ Box | Fountain Pen & Ink Subscription Box – Truphae](https://www.truphaeinc.com/pages/inkredible-box): Monthly subscription box delivering surprise fountain pens and inks to collectors.
